data.body: BuildKit cache alarm cleared 2026-09-09T12:46Z / 05:46 PDT. Evidence: after bounded docker builder prune -af, docker system df reported Build Cache Size=0B/Reclaimable=0B/TotalCount=0; the next CloudWatch datapoint for rebar/host:docker_buildkit_cache_used_percent was 0.0 at 05:41 PDT; rebar-docker-buildkit-cache-high transitioned ALARM -> OK at 2026-09-09T05:46:21-07:00. Confirmed coverage by scaup cap: docker-storage-cap.sh --install says /etc/docker/daemon.json already carries modern builder.gc maxUsedSpace=5368709120 and the live daemon started after the policy, so the daemon-native BuildKit cap is in effect. The brief re-alarm was real over-cap accumulation from rebuild traffic (5.756GB/5.362GB observed against a 5 GiB share), not missing cap wiring; the cap + alarm surfaced the bounded generator and manual prune cleared it before root pressure (root 24% used).
